result.title: CLASP: Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling for Zero-Shot OOD Detection using Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging, yet existing approaches often rely on final-layer confidence or entropy-based layer selection, potentially missing complementary information. We show that low in-distribution (ID) confidence entropy does not reliably predict OOD discrimination. We introduce CLASP (Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling), an ID-only framework that jointly models layer--prompt responses and visual features. CLASP ranks visual encoder layers using Gaussian conditional mutual information and selects a compact subset through anchored spectral selection, without fixing the number of layers. It then combines the selected layer--prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and fits a single shrinkage-regularized Gaussian. OOD scores are computed using squared Mahalanobis distance, without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation. Across histopathology, chest X-ray, and brain MRI benchmarks with UniMedCLIP and BioMedCLIP, CLASP performs strongly under varied distribution shifts. On MIDOG near-OOD, it achieves 87.54% AUROC with UniMedCLIP, outperforming confidence-based baselines; with BioMedCLIP, it remains competitive but trails visual-only Mahalanobis modeling. Ablations highlight the value of layer--prompt interactions and cross-feature dependencies, while exposing shift-dependent contributions and limitations under semantic shifts.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CLASP，一个仅用 ID 数据的零样本 OOD 检测框架：用高斯条件互信息为视觉编码器各层排序，经锚定谱选择得到紧凑层子集，再联合 layer–prompt 响应档案与 PCA 压缩的视觉嵌入，拟合单个收缩正则化高斯并用平方马氏距离打分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「低 ID 置信熵不能可靠预测判别力」的诊断与按层筛选互补视觉信息的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据在哪一层被保留、以及 latent 相似度受深度与层选择影响的问题相关，可供核查层选择准则能否迁移到推理状态选取，但该文本身不涉及推理期状态生成。
